mapper.insert: insert into chat_message (user_id, session_id, role, content, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, session_id, role, content, created_at from chat_message where user_id = #{userId} and session_id = #{sessionId} order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from chat_message where user_id = #{userId} and session_id = #{sessionId}
